gaps.sentence: The committee reached its verdict after lengthy ___ (DELIBERATE).
gaps.explanation: 'After lengthy deliberation' — the noun for careful discussion.

gaps.sentence: She was ___ (GRATE) for all their support.
The village is ___ (ACCESS) only by boat.
gaps.explanation: 'Accessible' = easy to reach; the -ible spelling follows 'access'.

gaps.sentence: The factory will ___ (EMPLOY) fifty more workers next year.
gaps.explanation: The bare verb follows 'will': will employ.
'Trustworthy' = deserving trust; 'trusted' also works but 'trustworthy' is the quality.

gaps.sentence: The palace is open to ___ (VISIT) all year.

gaps.explanation: 'A brief introduction' — the noun from introduce.
